name: Dum-Dums Original Pops Lollipops
whyItWorks: Hard sugar candies dissolve slowly in the mouth via saliva, preventing bolus digestion in the stomach. Sucking on a pop promotes salivary enzymes and eases mild nausea during flare days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Suck on a pop slowly; do not bite down on hard candy to protect dental enamel.
